title: Drift-adaptive Representation Preservation for Domain-Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.06093v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained vision models provide strong general-purpose representations, but in Domain-Incremental Learning (DIL), where the input distribution changes sequentially, adapting to new domains often degrades performance on previously learned ones. We observe that forgetting is not uniform across domains and classes and is not explained by training order alone. This motivates us to track each past domain-class concept individually. We use representation drift, defined as the deviation of a past concept's current representation from a fixed anchor, as a measurable surrogate for forgetting risk. The measured drift then serves two complementary roles. A consolidation loss assigns stronger preservation to high-drift pairs, while prototype construction down-weights highly drifted domains to reduce their influence on the class reference. translated_title: 面向域增量学习的漂移自适应表征保持
translated_abstract: 预训练视觉模型提供了强大的通用表征，但在域增量学习中，输入分布会依次发生变化，适应新域往往会降低模型在先前已学习域上的性能。我们观察到，遗忘在域和类别之间并非均匀分布，且不能仅用训练顺序来解释。这促使我们对每个过去的域-类别概念进行单独跟踪。我们使用表征漂移——定义为过去概念的当前表征相对于固定锚点的偏差——作为遗忘风险的可测量替代指标。测量到的漂移随后发挥两个互补作用：一种巩固损失为高漂移的域-类别对分配更强的保持力度，而原型构建则降低高漂移域的权重，以减少其对类别参考的影响。因此，表征保持是根据测量到的漂移来分配的，而非基于假设的重要性。为了在……期间获得该信号（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将表征漂移作为遗忘风险的可测量替代指标，通过漂移加权的巩固损失和原型构建机制，在域增量学习过程中根据实际漂移程度自适应地分配表征保持资源。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using representation drift as a measurable surrogate for forgetting risk, adaptively allocating representation preservation in domain-incremental learning through a drift-weighted consolidation loss and drift-aware prototype construction.
